All matches on the 19th of September |sandbox = Yes |rewards_increase = None }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|Arrr!|In-Game Description}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== '''Talk Like a Pirate Day''', internally referred to as '''PirateHat''', is a cosmetic [[Modifiers|modifier]] that adds pirate hats onto every enemy. '''Talk Like a Pirate Day''' appears exclusively in [[Black Spot Exchange]]; it is active in all matches on that map. Previously, on the 19th of September, it is active on all maps to celebrate the International Talk Like a Pirate Day. It was first enabled on all maps on the 19th of September 2022. This was disabled from the 19th of September 2025 onwards as it would break game functionality. ==Effects== When active, '''Talk Like a Pirate Day''' modifier will add pirate hats onto every enemy. It does not override any cosmetic modifers. The pirate hat will be replaced by other modifiers' hats. On some enemies like the [[Reaver]], [[Fallen Jester]] and Legacy [[Normal]], the pirate hat may be much bigger than it should be. ===Enemy Appearance=== ''This does not include every enemy in the game, but only some to show the effects of the modifier.'' NormalARGH.png|[[Normal]] affected by the '''Talk Like a Pirate Day''' modifier. AbnormalARGH.png|[[Abnormal]] affected by the '''Talk Like a Pirate Day''' modifier. File:SpoooopyARGH.png|[[Ghost]] affected by the '''Talk Like a Pirate Day''' modifier. File:NinjaARGH.png|[[Hidden]] affected by the '''Talk Like a Pirate Day''' modifier. File:ReavARGH.png|[[Reaver]] affected by the '''Talk Like a Pirate Day''' modifier. File:JestARGH.png|[[Fallen Jester]] affected by the '''Talk Like a Pirate Day''' modifier. ==Trivia== *Weirdly, '''Talk Like a Pirate Day''' modifier uses the same icon as the [[Cowboy (Modifier)|Cowboy]] modifier. *Despite the modifier being called ''Talk Like a Pirate Day'', it does not make anyone like the [[Narrators]] talk like a pirate. *The pirate hat that is added onto every enemy is a remodelled version of the {{RLinkC|1028859|Pirate Captain's Hat}} accessory from the Roblox catalog. ==Update History== *'''19 September 2022''' - [[v1.3.2]]b **'''Talk Like a Pirate Day''' added. *'''5 August 2023''' - [[v1.8.4]] **'''Talk Like a Pirate Day''' is now active in [[Black Spot Exchange]]. *'''19 September 2025''' **{{Bug}} '''Talk Like a Pirate Day''' prevents matches from starting if activated on all maps through the annual Talk Like a Pirate Day activation. *'''19 September 2025''' - [[v1.74.0|v1.74.3f]] **{{Bugfix}} '''Talk Like a Pirate Day''' is no longer activated on all maps through the annual Talk Like a Pirate Day activation to stop it from breaking matches. {{ModifierNavBox}}
